title: Explicit coefficients on the integer-labelled category
statement: For C,J,s,R,a as in [def-sf-twisted-action-presentation-data], construct a presheaf of commutative rings on the category of [lem-sf-twisted-action-category]. Its restriction along degree-zero inclusion is naturally R, and the map on the degree-minus-one identity arrow s.inverse X to X is exactly a inverse at X. The construction uses only the prescribed data and proved coherence results.

source.place: Original twisted-site steps 1, 2, and the coefficient part of step 4. Agent variant motivated by Tag 00W0 (proposition-sheaves-on-group), not a claim that that tag proves the twisted assertion.

proof.text: Convert the given negative generator into a positive comparison using the chosen power comparison from s followed by its inverse to degree zero. Apply the fully proved IntegerShiftFromOne extension theorem to R with the naive opposite shift and the trivial shift on rings, obtaining coherent comparisons for all integers.

For a degree-n arrow f:X to s^n Y define its ring map as the inverse comparison at Y followed by R(f). Naturality and the addition axiom prove contravariant composition. The zero comparison proves identities and the natural restriction isomorphism.

The addition identity for minus one plus one, the same cancellation comparison used to define the positive generator, and the positive generator normalization recover the prescribed inverse a at minus one. This proves the stated generator identity.
